subject.title: Add session workspace file preview editing

question: Should OpenClaw core accept an admin-scoped `sessions.files.set` method for editing session workspace text files, and should this PR be rebased to carry that feature onto the current chat workspace UI?
rationale: The code can be made to work, but accepting a new workspace write surface and deciding whether to keep it broad or narrow is a maintainer security/product boundary choice.

options.title: Accept after rebase
options.body: Approve the admin-only writer and require the branch to reuse current `workspace-fs` and `chat-session-workspace` surfaces before merge.

options.title: Narrow the writer
options.body: Require a smaller write surface, such as only saving files already previewed or touched by the session, before accepting the feature.

options.title: Defer core editing
options.body: Keep current main's read-only viewer and close or defer this core editing direction if workspace mutation should not ship in Control UI.

recommendation.title: Accept after rebase
recommendation.body: Approve the admin-only writer and require the branch to reuse current `workspace-fs` and `chat-session-workspace` surfaces before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent current-main read-only viewer and chat workspace UI direction were authored by this owner, making them the best visible routing candidate for the product/security choice.
